title: stop hook burns a turn while the role that owns the missing artifact is still running
detail: session-size-warning (15.3M, 95 main-thread responses): each of 7 role spawns cost the orchestrator 3-4 responses at ~150K context, ~2.5M total with no work done. One of them is the stop-hook block that fires while the spawned role is still writing its report. The role's tier_resolved event (written by prusik tier resolve --role at spawn) is a system-computed in-flight signal: until that role's verdict or report lands, the stop hook could stay silent for the artifacts that role owns.
